posts.text: Hey everyone, I recently did a research on this co and wanted to see if you think this is an attractive entry price. The core thesis seems to hinge entirely on execution: if management can actually turn around TCNS (targeting breakeven by festive FY27) and stem the cash burn at TMRW (portfolio breakeven pushed to FY29), is the current valuation a bargain? Or is the deep pessimistic case, where ongoing structural cash burn and margin compression wipe out shareholder upside, already fully factored into the stock’s current price?
